title: Machine-Learning-Aided DFT-1/2 Calculations for Bandgaps of Zinc Oxide Thin Films
soWhat: Built a machine-learning model that predicts bandgaps of semiconductor materials, tuned the training architecture for the best accuracy, and checked the predictions against experimental values.
problem: Choosing the machine-learning architecture, then optimising and validating the model.
role: I trained a two-hidden-layer neural network (8 and 6 neurons) with a genetic algorithm, producing a model with a very small RMSE (0.016).
method: Verification runs on the predicted points confirmed errors below 5% against the reference values, which makes the model practically useful: it reduces the setup tuning needed for future semiconductor material simulations.
